desc_autostart: Starts HA DeskLink automatically on Windows startup
desc_ha_url: The URL of your Home Assistant instance (e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8123 or https://homeassistant.local:8123)
desc_hotkey_dashboard: Opens the HA Dashboard in a separate window.
desc_hotkey_qa: Opens a popup with quick-access buttons for HA entities. Example: Ctrl+Shift+H opens the popup, then you click e.g. 'Living Room Light' to toggle it.
desc_language: Selects the UI language. Custom languages can be added in the Lang/ folder.
desc_load_entities: Loads all available entities from HA. Click here first before adding a Quick Action.
desc_mqtt_broker: Hostname or IP of the MQTT broker (e.g. homeassistant.local or 192.168.1.100)
desc_mqtt_enabled: Connects HA DeskLink additionally via MQTT to HA. Enables: Media Player control, commands to sleeping PC, more reliable connection.
desc_mqtt_fallback: Alternative broker address if the first one is unreachable (e.g. local IP if HA is accessed via domain). Leave empty for no fallback.
desc_mqtt_password: Optional. The password for the MQTT user. Leave empty for anonymous access.
desc_mqtt_ssl: Encrypts the MQTT connection. Disable for local broker without certificate.
desc_mqtt_username: Optional. Leave empty for anonymous access. Usually only needed for external brokers.
desc_notif_monitor: Which monitor should display notifications? Only relevant with multiple monitors.
desc_notif_position: Where on the screen should HA notifications appear?
desc_quickactions_intro: Define entities from Home Assistant as quick-access buttons. Press the configured hotkey (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+H) to open a popup. There you can toggle entities with one click — e.g. lights, blinds, switches.
desc_reregister: Re-registers all sensors with HA. Helps when sensors are missing or show wrong values.
desc_reset_device: Creates a new device ID. The old device remains in HA — must be deleted there manually. Also helps with 'Re-register Sensors' if sensors are missing or show wrong values.
desc_sensor_interval: How often sensor data (CPU, RAM, etc.) is sent to HA. Lower = more current, higher = saves resources.
desc_ssl: Enable for HTTPS connections. Disable for self-signed certificates.
desc_theme: System: Follows the Windows setting. Light/Dark: Fixed choice independent of the system.
desc_token: Create a Long-Lived Access Token in HA: Profile → Security → Create Token
desc_update_channel: Stable: Only tested versions. Pre-Release: Also beta versions with new features.
error_token_load: Could not load token. Please reconfigure the app.
ma_host_desc: Host or IP of the MA server
ma_host_tooltip: Host/IP of your Music Assistant server (TrueNAS app or HA add-on)
ma_port_desc: API port of the MA server
ma_token_desc: Token from MA web UI (profile → tokens)
ma_token_tooltip: Long-lived access token from the MA web UI (profile → tokens)
mqtt_feature_media_player: Media Player — PC as playback device
mqtt_no_mosquitto: Mosquitto not found. Please install the Mosquitto Add-on in Home Assistant (Settings → Add-ons → Mosquitto Broker).
no_connection: No saved connection. Please restart the app.
quickactions_empty:

settings_extra_note_reregister: This re-registers all sensors in Home Assistant.

settings_qa_select_first: Please select a Quick Action first!
settings_quickactions_desc: Enter entity ID and name for Quick Action buttons.
settings_reregister_confirm:

settings_reset_device_confirm:

tooltip_autostart: Start HA DeskLink automatically on Windows startup
tooltip_edit_qa: Edit or delete the selected Quick Action
tooltip_ha_url: The URL of your Home Assistant instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:8123

tooltip_save: Save all settings (URL, token, interval, language, etc.)
tooltip_sensor_interval: How often sensor data is sent to HA (10-300 seconds). Default is 30s.
tooltip_theme: System: Follows Windows setting. Light/Dark: Fixed choice.
tooltip_token: Long-Lived Access Token from HA: Profile → Security → Create Token

widget_desc_intro: Desktop widgets sit behind the desktop icons (WorkerW layer) and show live values or toggles. To reposition: enable Test mode and drag the widget with the right mouse button.

stream_enabled_desc: Lässt diesen PC als Music-Assistant-Player erscheinen — Musik aus der App auf PC-Lautsprecher/Kopfhörer.
